name: html-to-blocks
description: Agent workflow and MCP tools for transforming designed or provided HTML/CSS/JS into editable WordPress blocks.

interface.shortDescription: Transform designed HTML into editable WordPress blocks.
interface.longDescription: A staged html-to-blocks workflow for importing or generating high-quality HTML/CSS/JS mockups, planning core/custom WordPress blocks, generating vanilla JS custom blocks only when needed, assembling data-only block trees, and iterating with rendered/editor screenshot diffs until visual fidelity is high.
capabilities: Rendered and editor visual diff loops
interface.defaultPrompt: Transform this designed or provided HTML into editable WordPress blocks with the html-to-blocks workflow.
